title: humanoid_parkour round input
description: Evaluation shape for one round. The course is GENERATED from the round's master seed inside the referee (env.course.generate_course); the instance suite is a stratified friction sweep over that course (env/sim.instance_spec). Note the platform does not validate this schema on the spec-driven path — the scheduler skips it ('no legacy input schema to apply') and the worker passes the input to the referee verbatim — so treat it as documentation, not as a guard.

seed.description: Round master seed; picks the course. Written by the platform's round generator (APEX-97 mints a fresh 31-bit seed per round) and injected into the referee sandbox only, as SEED. Not miner-visible while the round is active. Optional here because the referee reads SEED from its environment; when absent the platform's _extract_base_seed yields 0, which would pin every round to the same course.

num_instances.description: Evaluation instances. Friction levels are spread evenly across the range, so this also sets how finely the grippy-to-slippery continuum is sampled.

max_steps_per_episode.description: Control-step cap per instance (1 step = 20 ms sim time, so 4000 = 80 s).

deadline_ms.description: Per-/act deadline for the policy, enforced by the referee's HTTP client.
